name: Lolita Kankin Mura ~Kachiku Shoujo ga Dekiru made~
original_name: ロリータ監禁村～家畜少女ができるまで～
source:
Petite Natsu and her friend Hina are just two innocent country lolis...
They didn't heed the warning not to go outside at night.
Now they're turned into livestock mating slaves, raped again
and again and again...

[Adapted from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084015.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
身材娇小的夏和朋友雏，只是两个天真无邪的乡下幼女……
她们没有听从警告，夜里偷偷跑出门。
如今，两人被变成家畜般的交配奴隶，一次、一次、又一次地遭到强暴……

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084015.html]DLsite English[/url]]
